propositions: Commit d9e0f0e733 introduced unconditional top-level imports of `from rebar_reconciler import git_adapter` at two locations, breaking standalone-by-path module execution
The reconciler engine is intentionally packaged so the top-level `rebar_reconciler` package is absent in normal in-process environments, causing ModuleNotFoundError on the unconditional imports
The bridge preview contention lock test fails at `_advisory_lock.py:83` because the module loads standalone by file path without package context, where no top-level package is available

Both `_advisory_lock.py:83` and `_ref_lock.py:194` must use `lazy_load("rebar_reconciler.git_adapter", "git_adapter.py")` to share the same canonical `sys.modules` key as unchanged package-context importers
Standalone-loaded modules must restore lazy-load behavior to function in environments where the top-level `rebar_reconciler` package is not installed
